basis: WOX13-clade homeobox; HCR RNA-FISH in the cap layers, rises during cap regeneration, and induces root cap cells when expressed in Arabidopsis (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). UniProt D8QUI1 calls it WOX8-1 and merges GeneIDs 9660776/9634901 (SELMODRAFT_404178/407157); Arabidopsis WOX13 is not a cap marker, hence requires=lycophyte. Independent support: the S. kraussiana reciprocal-best ortholog SkWOX13b (SK03G20400) is in the root cap stem cells and immature cap by in situ and enriched in the cap cluster 1 (pct 0.59 vs 0.15) (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol); already high, not raised. Sk-to-LOC mapping by reciprocal blastp, not checked in a database.

BEARSKIN-like NAC; HCR RNA-FISH in the cap layers and rises during cap regeneration (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Orthology to BRN1/2 unconfirmed: UniProt D8S100 (SELMODRAFT_451784) annotates it NST3/SND1-like and NCBI gives the same NAC105 name as SmVND1/2. Supported by S. kraussiana SkBRN/SMBa (SK07G06140, reciprocal-best hit) in the cap cluster 1, but only weakly specific (pct 0.94 vs 0.62) and no in situ (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol), whose own table gives ANAC007/VND4 as best Arabidopsis hit; not raised.

PLT/AIL AP2 factor; HCR around the apical initials in the distal meristem (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Marks a zone, not the initials alone. UniProt D8S2M3 (ANT-2, SELMODRAFT_107288); no PLAZA ID. Raised medium to high and evidence to function: the reciprocal-best ortholog SkeuANTa (SK01G03180) is in situ across the whole RAM including the apical cell, enriched in meristem cluster 2, and partly rescues Arabidopsis plt3 plt5 plt7 lateral rooting (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Still a meristem-zone marker: requires apical position to call initials.

euANT/PLT AP2 factor; S. kraussiana SkeuANTb (SK01G05700) by in situ in some RAM cells and at new RAM initiation sites, auxin-induced, and partly rescues Arabidopsis plt3 plt5 plt7 (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Not in Table S2; only in the dot plot for cluster 0, whose DE genes are lignin/suberin genes. S. moellendorffii LOC mapped by reciprocal blastp via a 157-aa UniProt fragment (D8RSY0, SELMODRAFT_17085); second hit SmPLTe.

REVIEW: PIN homolog in the outer layers by HCR and smFISH; layer (epidermis vs outer cortex) inferred from images, and also a top gene of the cortex region cluster (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). SELMODRAFT_422990.

SCARECROW ortholog; HCR and colorimetric in situ in the inner ground tissue around the stele, and partly complements Arabidopsis scr-4 (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Domain may include inner cortex: confirm with CASP1. UniProt D8TF12 (SELMODRAFT_432115); same gene as LOC112344873. Raised medium to high: the reciprocal-best ortholog SkSCRb (SK03G00050; note swapped a/b names) is in the endodermis by in situ, absent from the apical cell, and the most specific cluster-7 gene (pct 0.32 vs 0.005) (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Sk-to-LOC mapping inferred by reciprocal blastp.

Second NCBI locus of SmSCRa (paper Data S1A lists LOC112344873 and LOC9638011 for SMO351G0478); evidence as the LOC9638011 row (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Raised medium to high with LOC9638011: S. kraussiana SkSCRb in situ in the endodermis (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol).

SCARECROW paralog; in situ with sense control (Fig S2) and complements Arabidopsis scr-4 (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol); HCR anti-localized with SmSHRa (Hawinkel et al. 2026 Genome Biol, same lab). Pattern taken from the legend only. UniProt D8SFY3 (SELMODRAFT_116328); same gene as LOC9652292. S. kraussiana SkSCRa (SK07G02910; swapped name) maps to this gene (best hit LOC9652292, also LOC9635947) and appears in the cluster-7 dot plot only, not in Table S2 (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol); too weak to raise.

Second NCBI locus of SmSCRb (paper Data S1A lists LOC9652292 and LOC9635947 for SMO347G0264); evidence as the LOC9635947 row (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). S. kraussiana SkSCRa (SK07G02910) reciprocal-best hit; cluster-7 dot plot only (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol); not raised.

CASP-like; smFISH signal scattered around the stele, layer inferred from the figure image (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). The root forms a Casparian strip, but specificity is unproven. SELMODRAFT_441645.

Casparian-strip LRR-RLK; S. kraussiana SkSGNa (SK02G06140), called SGN1-like in the text but GSO1/SGN3 as best hit in the paper table, cluster-7 dot plot only (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Conflict: blastp ties with LOC9652543 (SmSGNb), which is stele by smFISH (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol).

REVIEW: most specific annotated cluster-7 gene, S. kraussiana SK01G17380 (log2FC 1.32, pct 0.46 vs 0.04) (Liu et al. 2023 Table S2). HD-ZIP III marks stele/procambium in seed plants, so cluster 7 may include inner stele cells. Reciprocal-best hit D8SLJ8 (C3HDZ1-1).

SHORT-ROOT ortholog that complements shr-2; few smFISH transcripts near the SCR domain (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol); HCR anti-localized with SmSCRb (Hawinkel et al. 2026 Genome Biol, same lab). SELMODRAFT_450138. Raised low to medium: the reciprocal-best ortholog SkSHRa (SK10G17230) is in the vasculature of the RAM and above by in situ (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol Fig 4C-D); scRNA signal weak there too.

Top gene of the vasculature region clusters and stele-wide by smFISH (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol); function unknown. Most panel genes are mainly in central tissue (Hawinkel et al. 2026), so check specificity against outer-tissue markers.
AHP6 homolog; stele by smFISH (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). UniProt D8R529 merges GeneIDs 9652598/9657836.
PIN1-like auxin efflux carrier; stele by smFISH (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). UniProt D8SK08 (SELMODRAFT_234325).

SGN3-like LRR-RLK, expressed in the stele rather than the endodermis by smFISH (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). SELMODRAFT_60230. Conflict: S. kraussiana SkSGNa (SK02G06140) ties between this gene and LOC9653216 by reciprocal blastp and is in the endodermis cluster 7 dot plot (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol); kept in Stele from the Yang smFISH, see the LOC9653216 row.

CLV1/BAM receptor kinase; S. kraussiana SkBAM1 (SK10G05700) enriched in vasculature cluster 6 (log2FC 1.08, pct 0.84 vs 0.21), no in situ (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Reciprocal-best hit D8R2D9 (SELMODRAFT_83051); near-identical paralog LOC9646948.
CLERK/CIK co-receptor; S. kraussiana SkCLERK (SK10G09340) enriched in vasculature cluster 6 (pct 0.51 vs 0.11), no in situ (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Blastp ties between LOC9663247 and LOC9658791.
TMO5 bHLH; a single cell file by smFISH, called xylem in the Fig S2B legend, co-expressed with SmVND1 (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). SELMODRAFT_412681.
VND-clade NAC; sparse smFISH along the SmTMO5b file (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). UniProt D8QQ16 calls it VND2-1 (SELMODRAFT_402243); NCBI name NAC105.

VND-clade NAC in one strong cell file, called phloem in the Fig S2A legend (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Conflict: VND genes mark xylem in seed plants; confirm it excludes SmTMO5b. UniProt D8RAM9 calls it VND4-2 (SELMODRAFT_89986).

B-type cyclin (G2/M); patchy meristem smFISH that drives the meristem region clusters, 40% of all panel transcripts (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). The paper writes SmCYB2;4; UniProt D8R4N3 calls it CYCB1-1 and merges GeneIDs 9635280/9640078. Independent support: S. kraussiana SkCYCB2;4 (SK03G12120, reciprocal-best hit) is specific to the dividing cluster 8 (log2FC 2.98, pct 0.81 vs 0.02) (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol); already high.

A-type cyclin (S to G2/M); patchy meristem smFISH (Yang et al. 2023 Curr Biol). UniProt D8RMN9 (CYCA1-1, SELMODRAFT_412894). S. kraussiana SkCYCA1;1a (SK01G15410) is specific to dividing cluster 8 (pct 0.41 vs 0.01) (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol), but its blastp ties with SmCYCA1;1b LOC9651297, so not raised.

G2/M B-type CDK; S. kraussiana SK10G01550 is the top dividing cluster-8 gene (log2FC 4.36, pct 0.95 vs 0.07) (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Blastp ties with LOC9633858 (possibly the other haplotype of the v1.0 assembly).
Cytokinesis kinesin (NACK1/TES/HINKEL); S. kraussiana SK05G00410 specific to dividing cluster 8 (pct 0.89 vs 0.05) (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Blastp ties with LOC9651829.

Spindle microtubule protein TPX2; S. kraussiana SK07G09960 specific to dividing cluster 8 (pct 0.81 vs 0.01), single-cell evidence only (Liu et al. 2023 Curr Biol). Reciprocal-best hit D8SMP2 (SELMODRAFT_423729).
